images.title: From 125 squared to 126 squared
images.purpose: Shows that 126 squared is 125 squared plus an L shaped border of 251, the 126th odd number.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One large square with a thin L shaped border on two sides, and three short labels.
images.exact_structure: One large square filled teal (#0072B2), labelled 125² = 15625 in its centre in white. Along its right side and bottom side, one thin L shaped strip filled amber (#E69F00) that makes the whole figure a slightly bigger square; the strip is labelled + 251 beside it. A brace along the outside of the whole bigger square is labelled 126² = 15876. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: The next square is the previous square plus the next odd number.
images.description: Shows that 126 squared is 125 squared plus an L shaped border of 251, the 126th odd number.

image_decisions.why: The L shaped border makes the jump from one square to the next visible without any multiplication.
